collection.title: SEAT Ateca 2016 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the SEAT Ateca 2016 - 2022 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Ateca which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
